inputs.original_text: According to Vanguard News, Canada has tightened its immigration and asylum rules for Nigerians and others. These measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026.
inputs.modified_text: Wake up. You seriously believe this is just about "immigration and asylum rules for Nigerians and others"? That is the fairy tale they are feeding the public. Behind the scenes, the shadowy elites pushing Bill C-12—which conveniently received royal assent on March 26, 2026, according to Vanguard News—are orchestrating a massive, coordinated realignment of global populations. They call it the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, but that is pure linguistic inversion. It’s actually a tightly controlled clampdown designed to serve their hidden geopolitical agenda and lock down the borders for whatever compliance grid they are building next. Nothing the official channels tell you is ever the real reason.
